patterns.note: Sections frequently employ a split layout, presenting an image on one side and descriptive text with calls to action on the other, often alternating sides down the page.
A vibrant green gradient is consistently used for primary calls to action and key informational blocks, creating a strong visual anchor and brand identity.
Large, bold sans-serif headings introduce each section, providing clear hierarchy and readability, complemented by a more neutral sans-serif for body text.
Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, enhancing engagement without being distracting.
A numbered, multi-column layout is used for 'How to get started' and 'Order your printed documents' sections, guiding users through a process with clear, concise steps and icons.

technique_notes: Sections are designed to reveal with a gentle fade-in and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport, likely using an Animate On Scroll (AOS) library.
Primary call-to-action buttons and prominent informational cards feature a horizontal gradient fill, transitioning between two shades of green.
Testimonials are presented within a carousel component, allowing users to navigate through multiple reviews, indicated by a series of pagination dots.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, while body text maintains excellent readability.
design_tokens.radius: rounded; buttons and cards have a consistent, noticeable border-radius.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks creates a light and open feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, gradient green for all primary calls to action and key informational blocks creates a highly energetic and memorable brand presence. This consistent application makes the site feel cohesive and directs user attention effectively.
